title: One-year eye-to-eye comparison of wavefront-guided versus wavefront-optimized laser in situ keratomileusis in hyperopes

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (Dove Medical Press; article <license> and ali:license_ref)

indication: hyperopia with or without astigmatism; randomized eye-to-eye comparison, 22 eyes of 11 patients

groups.description: Wavefront-guided LASIK (VISX Star CustomVue S4 IR), 150 kHz IntraLase iFS flap; one eye per patient, randomized
Wavefront-optimized LASIK (WaveLight Allegretto Eye-Q 400 Hz), 150 kHz IntraLase iFS flap; fellow eye of the same patients

series.notes: mean ± SD with the range in the same cell (range not used); n from the table header; per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD with the range in the same cell (range not used); n from the table header; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Tab3 (UDVA thresholds, CDVA lines, SE within ±0.25/±0.50/±1.00 D of emmetropia)

exclusions.reason: plots and proportions are not admissible

notes: Two excimer platforms (wavefront-guided and wavefront-optimized profiles) compared without an investigational agent: both groups are control.
Target recorded plano: predictability is reported as SE within ±0.25, ±0.50 and ±1.00 D of emmetropia; no monovision or other target is mentioned.
Method unstated: Methods list preoperative manifest and cycloplegic refraction; the method of the tabulated SE is not stated.
Contralateral design: the two groups are the two eyes of the same 11 patients; randomization placed 8 of 11 distance-dominant eyes in the wavefront-guided group.
Sphere, astigmatism, visual acuity, contrast sensitivity and higher-order aberrations are tabulated but not extracted.
